mainText: Hello, Verona! At 9 AM, it is a clear 50 degrees at Verona Area High School with a moderate air quality alert in effect.

The city has two important updates. First, the Senior Center is offering flexible, catered meal options for seniors that you can pick up daily. Second, construction on the Mark Drive reconstruction project is moving along, with underground utility work finished and concrete work currently underway.

There is plenty to do in our community. Today, you can join Yoga at Insight Wellness, check out the creativity at ART House 360, or participate in Hop Haus Trivia. Tomorrow, look forward to live music at Bailey's Run and Lake Lou-ee.
The Verona Police Department reported that on Thursday, October 15, an officer arrested a school bus driver for O W I after a report of dangerous driving behavior.
Today's delicious flavor is Dark Chocolate PB Crunch. The store opens today at 10:00 AM, so be sure to stop by and enjoy a scoop.
